bagPolicy.summary: Bags under 20”x20”x10” are allowed at the Newport Folk Festival. Larger bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: On site parking is limited at Fort Adams State Park, and purchasing a parking pass in advance is strongly encouraged. On site parking sales are credit card only, and once full, attendees will be directed to an offsite satellite lot. Parking for patrons with disabilities is available with a designated lot and shuttle service.

rideshare.note: Follow the signs for designated dropoff and pickup locations for ridesharing services.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Newport Folk Festival varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: There will be a shuttle bus fitted with a wheelchair accessible lift to bring patrons from the parking lot directly to the event entrance, running from 9am until the end of the day. Animals whose sole function is to provide comfort or emotional support do not qualify as service animals under the ADA and are not permitted at the festivals.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Newport Folk Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Newport Folk Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Newport Folk Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
